column1: # Q47 — motions the 21 engine-forced `em001_00` cells can play.
# Source of truth: disassembly of MHGU main 1.4.0 (vaddr = flat - 0x100) via the mhgu_re_* devices.
# `handler` = L2 table target for the variant (from G:/tmp/slices/sr-q29/l1l2-em001.json, targets[] = base + entries[]);
#            when that target is a tail-call stub the callee and its literal argument follow after "->".
# `motion_ids` = motion id (lmt*256 + index) in the r1 slot of a play-family call (0xafda4 / 0xaff40 / 0xaff48 / 0xaffac).
#            `[U]` = the id is NOT a code literal: it is read out of a record, and the read site is quoted in `note`.
# `shipped_in_inventory` = per id: `shipped` if MHRS-private/kb/gu-motions-all.tsv holds the clip for em001_00,
#            then its move-inventory visibility: `tree` = appears in at least one em001_00 moves.tsv row whose cell is in
#            the 236 (pairs.json); `forced-only` = only under non-tree cells (i.e. a screen keyed on the 236 loses it).
# `-` = the cell plays no motion at all.
